name: Rob the Rich
description: Loxley, the self-styled Robin Hood of the Mojave, needs a capable point-rider to intercept a Crimson Caravan shipment bound for Harwick — a price-gouging merchant who hoards vital supplies while nearby settlements starve. Loxley intends to redirect the goods to Freeside and the squatter camps along Route 15.
lore: Long before the bombs fell, stories circulated of a Saxon outlaw who robbed from the wealthy nobility and gave to the rural poor. Somewhere in the irradiated Mojave, that legend found fertile soil. Loxley's Merry Men number fewer than a dozen, but their reputation for hitting caravans without casualties — and the subsequent floods of food into struggling camps — has made them something approaching heroes in the squatter warrens. The Crimson Caravan Company does not share this assessment.

objectives.description: Locate the Crimson Caravan shipment on Nipton Road
Intercept the caravan — through negotiation, distraction, or force. No killing unless fired upon.
Separate the hoarded supplies from Harwick's legitimate cargo
Deliver the redirected supplies to Freeside and the Route 15 squatter camps

endings.description: You talked down the caravan guards and redirected the goods without bloodshed. Loxley names you an honorary Merry Man.
endings.consequence: Crimson Caravan begins routing their Nipton Road shipments with heavier armed escorts. Squatter camp morale improves for two weeks.

endings.description: You fought off the caravan guards. The goods reach the camps, but Crimson Caravan puts a bounty on Loxley's head.
endings.reward: Merry Man Token + 80 Caps, but Crimson Caravan caravans will now be hostile on sight
endings.consequence: Loxley is forced to relocate his camp south. He is philosophical about it.

endings.description: You tipped off Harwick's men. Loxley narrowly escaped capture. The goods go to Harwick.
endings.consequence: Loxley disappears from the Mojave. Squatter camps receive nothing. Harwick quadruples his water prices.
